template_name: Panzer IV Ausf D/E Infantry Support Platoon
historical_context: Panzer IV with short 75mm gun served as infantry support tank in 1941. Primary role was HE fire support rather than anti-tank combat. Each battalion had 10 Panzer IV tanks.

Panzer IV Ausf D/E.notes: Short 75mm for HE support. Not primary anti-tank vehicle in 1941.

strengths: Excellent HE round for infantry support
Effective against soft targets, fortifications, gun positions
Mobile enough for desert warfare (42 kph)
Can engage tanks at close range with HE
weaknesses: Not effective against heavily armored tanks (Matilda II)
Best used in support role, not tank-vs-tank combat
tactical_notes.typical_deployment: Support Panzer III tanks with HE fire. Engage infantry, gun positions, and fortifications. Provide fire support for combined arms attacks. Stay behind Panzer III in tank battles.

phase_6_data_source.notes: Mix of Ausf D and E variants
